role: design previews only, not implemented UI or approved runtime assets

prompts.inventory:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: PixelStreet inventory redesign concept, high fidelity flat 2D game screenshot, not a photographed device.
Input image 1 (supply-room.png) is STYLE reference only: warm amber wood, weathered brass, emerald accents, subtle cozy fantasy pixel illustration; do not reproduce a room as interface. Input 2 (food-goods.png) is EXISTING ITEM ART reference. Input 3 (companions-v2.png) is CHARACTER rendering/style reference.
Create ONE clean usable inventory panel, landscape 1200x1000-ish proportion suitable for scaling to a 760x650 desktop window, fully front-on with absolutely readable large simplified Chinese labels, minimal text. Use restrained dark walnut framing, warm ivory matte surfaces, moss green inset slot backgrounds, small brass edge accents. No excessively ornamental filigree, no large scenery behind items, no dense tiny text.
Exact title text at top left: "背包". Top right coin icon + "248", an icon-only close X. A centered full body young adventurer in practical brown leather with a green cloak, rendered as refined 2D pixel illustration, clear silhouette on a quiet desaturated circular display base. THREE square equipment slots vertically to the left and THREE to the right, SIX total, 3 plus 3: helmet, armor, gloves, boots, mainhand, accessory. Keep equipment icons simple. This equipment is conceptual layout, not claim of implemented equipment rules. Avatar occupies at most the upper 40 percent of the panel; no oversized portrait. Only short small label below "旅人".
Below avatar, one row of only four tabs: "全部" "材料" "补给" "装备". Then an EIGHT-column by THREE-row inventory grid, EXACTLY 24 visible square cells. Show ONLY 14 occupied cells and 10 truly empty cells. Occupied cells show item artwork and a legible number bottom right, absolutely no item names beneath the icon: flour sack 24, green gel 6, ration bundle 8, glowing magic meal 2, herb 13, berries 18, mushrooms 5, moonstone 9, tea cup 3, berry biscuits 4, soup 2, pumpkin 2, pale snow flower 1, star dust 7. Use reference food shapes recognizable at a glance. Empty slots are blank lined squares, not question marks or silhouettes of unowned items.
One herb item cell hovered: bright ivory-gold outline and very subtle lighter background, visible white pointing-hand cursor at its edge (the cursor must be visibly a pointing hand, not arrow). No tooltip in this main composition. Other cells stay quiet. Make occupied content feel like a fantasy action RPG inventory integrated with the current cozy painterly pixel art, with more clean space and less decoration than the reference background. Bottom right a single small tidy sort icon, no explanatory prose, no quest lists, no banners. No rarity glow cloud, no all-over animation effects, no watermarks, no logos. Do not add extra equip slots or extra text.
prompts.states:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE two-state interaction design sheet for PixelStreet's inventory. Image 1 is the already designed inventory concept; preserve its warm walnut/ivory/moss-green/brass visual language, character, six equipment slots and clean icon grid, but give the interaction details priority. This is a concept sheet, not a game implementation.
Create a wide landscape sheet with TWO equally sized inventory detail crops side by side on a quiet dark walnut background, clear readable large Chinese typography. Small headings only: left "悬停", right "右键". No annotation paragraphs, no arrows labeling every part, no tiny text.
LEFT: crop of square icon-and-quantity inventory cells, only owned items. Hover over a bundle of herbs with quantity 13. The slot border is visibly ivory-gold and inner surface a little brighter BEFORE clicking. A white POINTING-HAND cursor rests on the herb slot. An anchored ivory tooltip next to the slot, with short exact Chinese text: title "晨露草", category "材料", body "用于调配萤露药剂". Include a larger herb icon in the tooltip. Tooltip leaves the hovered item visible and doesn't obscure its quantity. All non-hovered cells quiet and lower contrast.
RIGHT: a crop of the same inventory with a berry biscuit item quantity 4. Its square is highlighted and an anchored right-click menu appears next to it, designed as a restrained cream paper card with 4 large icon+text rows. Exact text: "查看详情", "分享卡片", "使用", "售卖…". White pointing-hand cursor hovers the "分享卡片" row; this row immediately gets a moss-green background and light text, before pressing. Clearly separate menu rows and leave comfortable targets. Do not show a Send action, recipient, price, currency transaction, actual gifting, commerce confirmation or additional persistent systems. Sharing means a display-only card as a proposed design.
NO OTHER TEXT. Preserve crisp, cozy fantasy painted-pixel art and a readable game UI; no photorealism, no 3D device, no watermarks, no particle effects. Make hover selection visually unmistakable without using a flashing glow or layout movement.
prompts.items:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PixelStreet inventory item ICON ATLAS candidate.
References: Image 1 props.png defines FLOUR SACK, GEL IN A BOTTLE, TRAVEL RATION and MAGIC MEAL subjects (ignore the reference's backdrop completely); image 2 food-goods.png defines food object rendering; image 3 goods-v2.png defines crafted product silhouettes (ignore backdrop). Match their cozy fantasy refined painted-pixel illustration style, warm top-left lighting, crisp compact silhouettes, emerald/ivory/amber palette. This is a clean production-style atlas candidate, not a poster or interface.
Draw EXACTLY 25 isolated SINGLE ITEM ICONS in an EXACT 5 column by 5 row evenly spaced square atlas, transparent RGBA background. Every cell is same size, every item fully inside its own cell with generous transparent padding at least 15 percent on each edge. Uniform apparent scale. Each icon must be recognizable at 48–64 pixels. No shadow or glow bleeding into adjacent cells.
STRICT left-to-right top-to-bottom ordering:
ROW 1: [1 canvas flour sack with small wheat mark] [2 round corked glass jar containing translucent green GEL, no face, no creature] [3 small travel ration bundle of bread wrapped in cream cloth, NOT a large basket] [4 magic meal in small ceramic bowl with one violet crystal garnish] [5 bundle of fresh morning-dew green herbs with tiny white flowers].
ROW 2: [6 cluster of sweet red berries] [7 two blue-cap glowing mushrooms, no face] [8 jagged lavender-blue moonstone ore] [9 herbal tea in a moss-green ceramic cup] [10 three round golden berry jam biscuits].
ROW 3: [11 mushroom soup in a brown handled bowl] [12 single orange pumpkin with green stem] [13 two pale blue-white snowflowers] [14 slice of pumpkin pie on a small cream plate] [15 warm snowflower tea in a white porcelain cup].
ROW 4: [16 small heap of sparkling gold star-dust on a tiny dish, no bottle] [17 woven traveller picnic basket with bread and berries] [18 open compact wooden meal box with mushroom stew] [19 small wrapped purple star-candy gift box] [20 leaf-stopper round glass dew potion, pale green liquid].
ROW 5: [21 short square dark-blue star-ink bottle with a white quill] [22 refined turquoise crystal INGOT cut as a clean rectangular bar, distinct from raw jagged ore] [23 small rounded amber companion nectar bottle decorated with red berries] [24 short green old-wood fragrance bottle with a mushroom stopper] [25 faceted pale-blue frostflower crystal bottle with a snowflower cap].
Exactly FIVE rows and FIVE columns, 25 items, no extras, no repeated icons, no decorative plants outside an icon, no terrain, no scene backgrounds. NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO cell frames, NO grid lines, NO watermark. Green gel absolutely MUST be an inanimate jar of liquid; never draw the pet slime. Keep all item/quantity text for later real UI rendering. Preserve genuine transparent background everywhere outside the items.
prompts.inventoryFix:

Preserve Image 1's entire layout, colors, text, grid, white pointing-hand cursor, six equipment slots, character pose, clothing and framing unchanged. Do not redraw the interface or add elements.
Make ONLY inventory item identity corrections, using the corresponding items from reference Image 2: row1 col2 quantity6 must be an INANIMATE corked round glass jar containing green gel, with no face, no creature, no eyes; row1 col3 quantity8 must be cloth-wrapped travel bread rations rather than a wrapped gift; row1 col4 quantity2 must be a ceramic magic-meal bowl with a purple crystal garnish; row2 col3 quantity2 must be mushroom soup rather than orange stew; row2 col6 quantity7 must be a little dish of gold star dust rather than a bottle. Every other existing inventory icon and quantity stays unchanged. Keep correct herb quantity13 hovered. Items only, no background outside the panel changes, no added text, no watermark.
